summary.text: Dennis Riddell is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 64 in Alamance County since 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
The General Assembly lists his occupations as marine engineer, educator and thermographer.

paragraphs.text: Dennis Riddell earned a bachelor's degree from the California Maritime Academy and served in the U.S. Navy Reserve from 1978 to 1988, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as business owner, and the General Assembly lists marine engineer, educator and thermographer.
Riddell assumed office in the North Carolina House in 2013 and has served seven terms, according to the General Assembly.
The General Assembly lists a mailing address in Snow Camp.
The Republican primary scheduled for March 3, 2026, was canceled.
